name: billion-context-advisories
description: Critical-defect advisories for billion-context (#1481). Machine-readable blocklist consumed by the bili advisory watcher; published by CI from this repo's advisories/ directory.

advisories.reason: 中:v0.1.203–0.1.204 重启后可能丢失压缩状态,长会话上下文超限、以 502 终止且无法自愈——请立即升级到 0.1.207。EN: v0.1.203–0.1.204 may lose compression state after a restart; long sessions overflow the context window, die with 502, and cannot recover — upgrade to 0.1.207 now.
